subject: Scaling addendum & PO for Q3 capacity
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluehaven.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@bluehaven.io
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling addendum & PO for Q3 capacity

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the walkthrough on Tuesday — the product looks great and the team agrees we should move forward with the Q3 committed capacity add-on. Procurement asked me to loop you back on a couple of operational items so they can attach them to a PO:

- We need an invoice (or pro-forma) addressed to our EU legal entity (Bluehaven Europe B.V.) so we can attach it to the PO.
- Please confirm what tax documentation you need for EU VAT handling (we can provide VAT registration #, but we also usually request vendor-backed invoices that show VAT treatment).
- Our procurement team prefers Net60 but finance is flexible — can you confirm Redwood's standard net terms and whether Net60 is possible for this add-on?
- Who should be listed as the billing contact/email for invoice submission and remittance?

I've attached our PO template for your reference. If you can send a draft invoice that we can attach, procurement will get the PO queued quickly. Ideally we'd have the PO and invoice before May 20 so services can be scheduled for the start of Q3.

Appreciate it —
Liam

[Attachment: bluehaven_po_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluehaven.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling addendum & PO for Q3 capacity

Hi Liam —

Thanks, excited to get this moving. Quick summary and next steps so procurement has everything to attach to the PO: 

1) Invoice / pro-forma: we can issue a pro-forma invoice to Bluehaven Europe B.V. and then re-issue a final invoice once the PO number is provided. I attached a draft pro-forma for your review.

2) Tax docs: for EU VAT handling we need the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the invoice, the VAT registration number for Bluehaven Europe B.V., and confirmation whether Bluehaven will be VAT-paying (reverse charge vs. standard VAT). For US entities we request a W-9; for EU entities we request VAT reg. number and valid billing address.

3) Net terms: Redwood standard for add-ons is Net45. We can accommodate Net60 on multi-year commitments with finance approval; if procurement requires Net60 please flag and I will arrange expedited approval. If you can confirm PO terms now (Net45 vs Net60) we'll align the invoice accordingly.

4) Billing contact: please confirm the billing contact name/email to appear on the PO and for remittance notices. If you prefer we can send invoices to payments@bluehaven.io.

I put the HubSpot deal link here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DB-99817

Next steps from our side: I will loop in Billing (Ben & Neha) to prepare the pro-forma and reserve an invoice number for you; once we have the PO number we'll finalize the invoice and send a DocuSign amendment for the committed capacity addendum.

Attached: pro-forma draft (PDF).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: proforma_invoice_redwood_47392_draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Scaling addendum & PO — billing action required

Ben / Neha —

Forwarding Bluehaven's note. Procurement wants a pro-forma invoice addressed to Bluehaven Europe B.V. so they can attach it to the PO. Key pieces:

- Legal entity for invoice: TBD (they'll confirm exact spelling/address and VAT #)
- Offer Net45 as default; they may request Net60 (procurement preference). Please prepare the draft pro-forma with Net45 and include line items for: committed tokens (Q3 add-on), effective dates, and a note that invoice will be finalized once PO number received.
- Reserve invoice number: please reserve next available pro-forma/invoice number for this draft (mark as draft until PO attached).
- VAT handling: include a line in the draft for VAT treatment (0% reverse charge or VAT amount) and leave the VAT amount blank until they confirm VAT status.

Timeline: they'd like to have docs attached to PO by May 20. Can you confirm you can produce the finalized invoice within 24 hours of receiving the PO number? If Net60 would require finance signoff, flag here and I'll escalate.

Thanks — Priya

[Internal note: HubSpot deal DB-99817 — attach the draft invoice and create billing task for Neha]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluehaven.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@bluehaven.io
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scaling addendum & PO for Q3 capacity

Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirmed the PO this afternoon. Details below: 

- PO number: PO-47392-EU
- Invoice entity: Bluehaven Europe B.V.
- VAT number: NL123456789B01 (we'll also attach company registration and VAT cert if you need it)
- Terms: Net45 (procurement accepted Net45 for this order)

I've attached the signed PO for your records. Please issue the final invoice referencing PO-47392-EU and send the DocuSign amendment for the capacity add-on to my signature. Payments will be processed on Net45 from invoice date. Let me know if you need anything else.

Appreciate it —
Liam

[Attachment: signed_po_47392.pdf (application/pdf)]
